newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Trade in Bahrain stocks picks up, index higher.
newsitem.headline: Trade in Bahrain stocks picks up, index higher.

text.p: Bahrain's share index crept higher this week in active trade focused on bank shares, the Bahrain Stock Exchange said.
It said the index rose 3.28 points to 1,532.20 points in the week ending on Thursday from 1,528.92 points last week.
Trading volume climbed to 11.7 million shares worth 2.8 million dinars ($7.4 million) from 6.1 million shares worth 2.5 million dinars the previous week.
Shares of 21 firms were traded in 241 transactions.

National Bank of Bahrain shares dominated the market in terms of value traded with more than 1.2 million shares worth 504,272 dinars changing hands. The bank closed at 412 fils on Thursday, up six fils on the previous week.
On Monday the bank announced it had been awarded a mandate by the government to arrange a $520 million loan facility to finance a power and water project.
Al-Ahli Commercial Bank came next with 1.25 million shares worth 412,010 dinars changing hands. It closed at 332 fils, up 10 fils from last week.
Bahrain's bourse is open to nationals of the six Gulf Arab states -- Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Bahrain, United Arab Emirates and Kuwait.
